# Pre-processing large datasets for Rapid workflow

This workflow includes importing and organizing of large datasets for the rapid workflow to allow for quick re-runs of the rapid reports.

```{r}
source("setup.R")
```

# Create File Structure

First get list of all park names
```{r}
# get a list of all park names and filtered park list

#download a list of all park names and attributes
parks <- getParkSystem()

# clean file and join to list that has region codes
parks_filtered <- parks %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  # remove non  conus
  filter(!STATE %in% c("AK", "AS", "HI", "MP", "PR", "VI")) %>%
  distinct(STATE, UNIT_CODE)

# tie to unit list to get region code
nps_list <- readxl::read_xlsx("data/NPS-Unit-List.xlsx") %>% 
  # remove first row metadata
  slice(-1) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  dplyr::select(UNIT_CODE = park_code, region) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  inner_join(parks_filtered, by = "UNIT_CODE")
```

Now create folders if they don't already exist
```{r}
if(!dir.exists("data/rapid")) {
  dir.create("data/rapid")
}

# folder for conus or US wide data
if(!dir.exists("data/rapid/all")) {
  dir.create("data/rapid/all")
}

# folders for each park code
walk(sort(parks$UNIT_CODE), function(x){
  if(!dir.exists(paste0("data/rapid/", x))) {
    dir.create(paste0("data/rapid/", x))
  }
})

```


## Centroid Climate Data

Pull and save centroid climate data for all parks
```{r}
# initiate error handling
saferun <- safely(.f = get_centroid_climate_data)

# track progress
imap(sort(unique(parks$UNIT_CODE)), ~{
  message(glue::glue("Processing {.y} of {length(unique(parks$UNIT_CODE))}: {.x}"))
  saferun(park = .x, save = TRUE, path = "data/rapid")
})
```


Test running selection function with pre-pulled centroid climate data
```{r}
get_centroid_climate_data("BRCA", save = TRUE, path = "data/rapid")

test <- select_cfs_rapid(park = "BRCA", region = "SWR", pull_data = FALSE,
                         to_plot = TRUE, save = TRUE, path = "data/rapid")
```
